name: wmkf_granteedeliverable
description: One grantee deliverable package lifecycle row per akoya_request. Abstract text remains on akoya_request; this table owns package status, image metadata, invite date, and reminder date. At-most-one row per request is enforced by the wmkf_request alternate key.

primaryNameAttribute.description: Synthetic display name for the request's grantee deliverable package.

attributes.description: Lifecycle for the grantee deliverable package. Null/unset = not started. Mirrors shared/config/granteeDeliverableStatus.js.

options.label: Drafted
options.description: AI abstract prepared; invite not yet sent.

options.label: Invited
options.description: Magic-link invite sent to the grantee.

options.label: Reminder Sent
options.description: At least one reminder sent to a non-responder.

options.label: Submitted
options.description: Grantee submitted edited abstract + image + caption.

options.label: Staff Review
options.description: Submitted materials are under staff review.

options.label: Revision Requested
options.description: Staff requested a correction or replacement.

options.label: Closed No Response
options.description: Cycle deadline passed without a usable submission.

attributes.description: SharePoint URL/path/item reference for the grantee-submitted graphical image. Binary content lives in SharePoint.
Free-text image caption supplied by the grantee.
UTC date/time when the package first moved from Drafted to Invited.
UTC date/time when the automatic day-12 reminder was sent.

relationships.lookupDescription: The awarded request this grantee deliverable package belongs to.
